[TOC]

### Prerequisites:
- Prepare the matching AI model and enable the corresponding AI function

### Operation steps:

1. Download this configuration file template Click to download the configuration file compressed package [config.zip](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8f948996ae26bcbc27f36cf23ef5c1a5 "[config.zip") Local decompression
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=439939d4aeed81dabab0f3edc233bfa4)

1. Open the text editing tool and fill in the speed threshold on the right. For the specific meaning of the fields, refer to the parameter notes below:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=6c187b80c8203f95778d9ef7a610fba4)
> fFD_DsmLowVel;DSM alarm low speed threshold, unit km/h default 30
fFD_DsmHighvel;DSM alarm high-speed speed threshold, unit km/h default 50

 >fFD_Hmwvel;HMW alarm speed threshold, unit km/h 30.00
fFD_Fcwvel;FCW alarm speed threshold, unit km/h 30.00
fFD_Ldwvel;LDW alarm speed threshold, unit km/h 55.00
fFD_Pcwvel;PCW Alarm speed threshold, unit km/h 50.00

 >fFD_BsdFirstvel; BSD first-level alarm speed threshold, unit km/h 30.00 BSD algorithm library is not used
fFD_BsdSecondvel; BSD second-level alarm speed threshold, unit km/h 30.00
fFD_BsdThirdvel; BSD third-level alarm speed threshold, unit km/h 30.00

1. Unlock the device and remove the hard disk or SD card storage, use a hard disk reader or SD card reader to insert it into the computer, and open the root directory of the first storage partition
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=1af67e05be7087b5900c819dcaf652b3)
1. Copy the config file you just edited and saved to this directory, disconnect the device, insert the device and lock it
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5a7c4cedfdb1ba9476c4a63eda7b989b)
1. When the device is powered on, it will automatically import the configuration and restart. The configuration will take effect after the restart
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f29b6a7205685638632647c31d7ec5e4)
